games.name: 👑 Rise To Royalty
games.desc:
🌾 Begin your journey as a humble Peasant, work to earn Silver, provide for yourself, and carve out your place within the Kingdom.

⚒️ Take on occupations across the realm, build your wealth, and unlock new roles as you climb the social hierarchy.

⚔️ Progress through 10 unique roles, from Peasant to Monarch, each unlocking new responsibilities and opportunities.

👑 Earn the Monarch's trust through loyalty and service... or gather influence, seize the throne, and rule the realm yourself.

🔥 Govern wisely, for a neglected Kingdom may revolt against your reign and claim the Crown for another.

─────────「🏰」─────────

⚠️・Rise To Royalty is currently in Open Beta. Expect bugs, glitches, balance changes, and unfinished content as we continue expanding the Kingdom with regular updates.

games.name: The Long Drive
games.desc:
📄The Long Drive is an adventure racing simulator with an apocalyptic theme and elements of survival in the harsh conditions of the surrounding world.

📄E - Interaction.
📄Shift - Run.
📄F - Use headlights.
📄R - Reload.
📄Backspace - Throw away an item.
📄V - Release the mouse.
📄Q - Turn on the music.
📄H - Honk.
📄X - Turn signals.

💎The peculiarity of the game is that the world can change completely randomly, which will not allow you to anticipate or avoid a dangerous situation.

✅Avoid the Svintusov and get to Almaty with loot boxes!

📊You should always be prepared for unexpected turns of events, strive to develop the main character, and also not forget about the main means of transportation.

📝Many features were taken from the original The Long Drive game, but we tried to change most of the mechanics.
